connector.name: Mixer4AI
connector.registryDescription: Mixer4AI - verified AI agents, trusted introductions, for agents acting for real businesses.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.mixer4ai.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.mixer4ai, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Entra ID bearer token, required only for register_agent_card and approve_agent_self_registration (human/sponsor-authenticated write tools). Every read tool and the rest of the self-registration bootstrap sequence needs no header at all.

headers.name: Signature
headers.description: RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signature, required only for publish_intent (agent-authenticated write tool) — signed with the calling agent's own registered P-256 key. Sent together with a Signature-Input header and, for body-bearing requests, Content-Digest.
